description: This file is a Java implementation class for the service managing loan COB (Close of Business) catch-up operations in the Fineract microfinance platform. It provides methods to unlock locked loans, retrieve the oldest processed COB loan, execute a catch-up process asynchronously, and check if a catch-up is running.

classes.name: LoanCOBCatchUpServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the LoanCOBCatchUpService interface, providing methods for managing COB catch-up operations for loans as part of the Fineract financial platform.

methods.name: unlockHardLockedLoans
methods.description: Removes locks and unlocks loans that are hard locked for COB processing.

methods.name: getOldestCOBProcessedLoan
methods.description: Retrieves the oldest COB processed loan information, including loan IDs and the processed date.

methods.name: executeLoanCOBCatchUp
methods.description: Initiates asynchronous execution of the COB catch-up process for loans.

methods.name: isCatchUpRunning
methods.description: Checks whether a COB catch-up process is currently running based on job execution parameters.
